basis.change: Represent the Valve Stand as a Base assembly and place the protective-atmosphere piping and control devices beneath it.
basis.identityBoundary: Existing hierarchy-node IDs and component tags are preserved; only their governed parent relationship changes.

newAssembly.name: Valve Stand assembly
newAssembly.shortDescription: Groups the Base protective-atmosphere piping, pressure measurement and control devices installed at the valve stand.
newAssembly.longDescription: The Base Valve Stand provides the local protective-atmosphere piping and the pressure sensing, back-pressure control, oil-drain and exhaust-valve interfaces used around the Inner Cover atmosphere circuit.
newAssembly.operatingType: Gas-service piping, measurement and control assembly
newAssembly.sourceReference: Owner instruction dated 2026-08-20; SOM pp.53,205; MM pp.4-6
